nav.title: Add a book you have nearby
nav.text: Open Books: your library starts there.

addFirst.title: Add a book you have nearby
addFirst.text: Press “Add the first book” and pick a book within reach.

add.title: Add a book you have nearby
add.text: Press “Add” at the top and pick a book within reach.

isbn.title: Where is the ISBN
isbn.text: The ISBN is on the back of the book, above the barcode. If you can't find it, you can also “Enter by hand”.

save.title: Check the details and save
save.text: Take a look at the book's details, then press “Save”.

landed.title: Your first book
landed.text: {title} is the first book in your library.

nav.title: Give it a place
nav.text: Open Shelves: that's where the book finds its spot.

new.title: Give it a place
new.text: Create the unit where you keep your books: a name and how many shelves.

form.title: Give it a place
form.text: Pick a name and how many shelves the unit has, then save.

unplaced.title: Give it a place
unplaced.text: Drag the book onto a shelf, or use “Place”.

confirm.title: Give it a place
confirm.text: Choose the unit and the shelf, then confirm.

nav.title: Take it in your pocket
nav.text: Open Devices: that's where you connect your phone.

add.title: Take it in your pocket
add.text: Press “Add a phone” to carry your library with you.

qr.title: Take it in your pocket
qr.text: Point your phone's camera at it.

finale.title: Your library is ready
finale.text: Your first book has its place. Happy reading.

find.title: Find a book
find.text: Type a title or an author in «Search and commands», then open a book.

where.title: Where it is
where.text: «Show on the shelf» takes you to the cabinet and the shelf.

whereBack.title: Where it is
whereBack.text: Search for a book and open it: «Show on the shelf» is there.

reading.title: Mark what you read
reading.text: Say whether a book is to read, in progress or finished: only you see it.

readingBack.title: Mark what you read
readingBack.text: Search for a book and open it: that's where you mark your progress.

exploreFinale.title: Now you can find books
exploreFinale.text: You search, see where it is and mark what you read. Happy reading.

replay.title: The tutorial
replay.description: Starts again from the first step, with the path that fits your library.
